title: diff.output
description: Response envelope of the diff tool.

ok.description: false only when the tool could not run; an asset with errors in it is still ok:true

code.description: Stable, enumerable code — branch on this, not on message text

severity.description: error = fatal / will not load; warning = loads but likely wrong (or changed without being asked); info = advisory

prim_path.description: USD prim path, or the derived path for glTF objects (/Asset/<Node>_<i>/Prim_<j>, /Asset/Materials/…); "" for file-level

suggested_fix.description: Concrete next step, naming the tool call when one fixes it

errors.description: Every diagnostic (error, warning, info), errors first

summary.description: The change note: regressions first, then neutral changes. Read this first.

topology.description: Welded space; null when topology was disabled

meshes.description: Paired by prim path, then by unique name when nodes were renumbered

visual.description: Only with visual=true: front / side / top / iso SSIM, cameras fixed to the before framing

rule.description: Slash-namespaced rule id — the public API, e.g. topo/open-edges

pack.description: Versioned pack the rule belongs to, e.g. core-geometry@1

code.description: Alias code, the same one used in errors[]

default_severity.description: The pack's default, kept visible when a profile changed it

certainty.description: measured = a deterministic geometric fact; heuristic = carries confidence

message.description: What was found — counts only for measured rules

confidence.description: Authored prior for this pack version, not calibrated

findings.description: diff@1 rules: regressions at warning, neutral changes at info; mirrored into errors[]

lineage.description: An explicit statement that these two hashes are the same asset — feeds the usage lineage
